data.long_meaning: Azrielle is a Hebrew name meaning 'God is my help'. This name is derived from the Hebrew root 'azar', which means 'help' or 'aid'. In the Bible, God is often referred to as a source of help and strength for His people. The name Azrielle carries the meaning “God is my help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Azrielle usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my help and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azrielle total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: עזריאל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עזריאל (Azri'el) הוא שם נבואי, פרושו: "אל הוא עזר". במקרא, הוא מופיע כשם של מלאך. בערבית, הוא פרוש "אל שמח". בתנ"ך, שם הוא מופיע כשם של המלאך המפורש.

in_greek.name: Αζριήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Αζριήλ, (Αζρήλ), μετοχή της ουσίας Αζραήλ (Αζραήλ) που σημαίνει: πρίγκιπας του Θεού (Αγγέλος). Αφού, το όνομα του ονομάζεται ως: "πρίγκιπας του Θεού". Στο Παλαιό και Νέο Τέλος, το όνομα του φαίνεται στα ονόματα που αναφέρονται.

in_latin.name: Azrielle
in_latin.long_meaning: Azrielle, ex hebraico, rex Dei, laetitia, misericordia. In veteri et novo Testamento, apparet in nominibus qui referuntur.

in_english.name: Azrielle
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azrielle originates from the Hebrew name Azriel, meaning 'prince of God'. It is derived from the root 'Azar', signifying 'helper' or 'assistant'. In the Bible, the name is seen in the context of angels and heavenly beings. In Christian tradition, the name is associated with qualities of joy and mercy.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azrielle is a beautiful combination of theology and history. With its roots in Hebrew, Azrielle is a nod to the rich cultural heritage of the Jewish and Christian traditions. This name has been worn by many notable figures through history, including the late American actress and singer, Azrielle Testerman. The name evokes feelings of strength, resilience, and the unwavering presence of God.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Azrielle lies in its etymology and biblical roots. The name reminds us that God is our faithful helper and constant source of strength. As believers, we can draw inspiration and encouragement from this truth when we face challenges or hardships. By carrying the name Azrielle, one is constantly reminded of the promise that God is always there to aid, guide, and support us through every new adventure in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Azrielle: God's helper or assistance in divine grace. A name evoking a sense of divine intervention and aid in one's spiritual journey.

biblical_reference.note: In the Bible, Azrielle is the name of an angel who appears to the prophet Daniel.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Azrielle was a 5th century Celtic goddess of the hunt. The name Azrielle carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
